newsitem.title: USA: MFS Communications adds Internet services.
newsitem.headline: MFS Communications adds Internet services.

text.p: MFS Communications Co said Monday it will expand sales and marketing programs for UUNET Internet connectivity services.

UUNET currently provides high-speed Internet connections to more than 25,000 business customers worldwide, said MFS. Internet access speeds range from 56 kilobytes per second to 1.544 megabytes per second, said the company.
The expansion includes tripling its Internet services sales force, MFS said.
MFS offers communications services to businesses. It recently acquired UUNET Technologies Inc, an Internet services provider in Fairfax, Va.
